message.content: (((([[{{A larger ratio is not unambiguously better or worse. If you are minimizing the model-prefix repetition in the denominator and the ground-truth-prefix repetition is a fixed baseline, then a larger ratio is better because the denominator is smaller. If you are minimizing the numerator, or if the ground-truth condition also matters, then a larger ratio can be worse if it is driven by a larger numerator. If both numerator and denominator vary, the ratio alone is ambiguous; compare absolute repetition values in the condition you care about.}}]]))))
